candidate.answerReason: Triangle ADC has two equal sides and a 60-degree included angle, so it is equilateral and AC=17.

methods.label: Recognize an equilateral triangle
methods.explanation:
The diagonal \(AC\) is a side of triangle \(ADC\), so focus on that triangle. Since \(AD=CD=17\), it is isosceles, and its angles at \(A\) and \(C\) are equal. The three angles sum to \(180^\circ\), so
\[
\angle DAC=\angle ACD=\frac{180^\circ-60^\circ}{2}=60^\circ.
\]
All three angles are \(60^\circ\), making triangle \(ADC\) equilateral. Its sides therefore all have length \(17\), so \(\boxed{AC=17}\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
